bundle.shortDescription: Cloud-native desktop file manager for Fedora and GNOME
bundle.longDescription: AR Files is a cloud-native desktop file manager engineered for Fedora Workstation (GNOME 50 / Libadwaita). Instant browsing, sparse placeholder files, on-demand hydration, and never-freezing local-first SQLite metadata.
